name: camera pushes from a small logo lockup into an app screenshot, ending on the mark
looks: A small circular icon and wordmark sit together on a soft gradient field. The camera pushes slowly in and the field resolves into a zoomed app screenshot: a search bar, a couple of sidebar icons and a preview card peeking in from the edge. The push continues until only a circular badge with a few small colour chips orbiting it fills the frame.
build: One continuous camera dolly/FOV push (`transitions.md`'s push-in) across a single static or lightly-parallaxed screenshot layer; the UI chrome (search bar, sidebar icons, card) is positioned so new detail enters frame as the push continues, ending tight on the app's own circular mark with a few small coloured squares drifting around it on slow, offset orbits.
sound: A soft low whoosh that builds through the push, with a light shimmer as the small orbiting chips settle into view.
prompt: Open tight on a small circular mark and wordmark on a soft gradient field, then push the camera slowly in until the field resolves into an app screen: a search bar, a couple of sidebar icons, a card peeking in. Keep pushing until the frame holds on just the mark itself, now ringed by a few small colour chips on slow orbits.
